capabilities: Assign a Unicode symbol or emoji to a key
Insert a symbol at the cursor or over selected text
Replace or clear an assigned key
Save a separate layout per vault
disambiguation: Not a system keyboard remapper; it adds an on-screen symbol palette in the sidebar.
extras: Installed manually from a ZIP; assignments are stored per vault, and a separate Chrome extension keeps its own layout.
problem: Typing special Unicode characters and emoji in Obsidian means memorizing shortcuts or copying them from somewhere else.
summary: Sidebar keyboard that lets you assign Unicode symbols and emoji to keys and insert them at the cursor in a note.
